steps.warmUp: Warm up first, gently, as in the last lesson.
steps.close: Notes a step or two around your comfortable note again, to get back into it.
steps.inside: Before you sing, hear the note in your head for a moment, then sing it. Start it softly: it’s easier to tune a quiet note than to push a loud one into place.
steps.wider: Now a little further: up to a major third above or below your note.
